basic_info.description: Luxury loft with bright open spaces for living, working and entertaining and direct entrance from garage parking spot to four levels and three patios/terraces.  Enter the main level via inviting front patio to the open plan living, dining, half bath and chef's kitchen with Viking range and refrigerator, plenty of counter space, storage and skylight.  Primary suite downstairs has large enviable closet space and storage with custom built ins, a washer dryer in laundry room adjacent to a split bath with steam shower and another patio off the bedroom with direct access to the garage parking spot at street level. Second loft level bedroom has tons of windows, another great custom closet and bath with tub and tiled rain shower. Top loft office level with windows all around and a third top sunny roof deck overlooking the central courtyard of this cool building.
